free_tier.stated: No free text allowance; Grok models are billed per million tokens (e.g. grok-4.7 input USD 2.00, output USD 6.00 per 1M for prompts under 200k).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible client and the xAI SDK
chaining: no standing free tier published; usage is charged per token

limits.value: per-token billing; no free tier stated

identity_cost.detail: an account and API key; no card or phone gate stated on this page

reliability_note: long-context prompts (at or above 200k tokens) are billed at the higher rate for the whole request

evidence.proved: Grok models are priced per million tokens with no free tier
